3153294_fb8212bc.text: Early-generated glutamatergic neurons display distinct morpho-functional features that contribute to the functional diversity within the apparently homogeneous glutamatergic population (Marissal et al., 2012).

3153294_b3d2b495.text: Early-generated glutamatergic neurons display distinct morpho-functional features that persist from the juvenile through the adult hippocampus (Marissal et al., 2012). This sub-population of early-generated glutamatergic neurons impacts network dynamics when stimulated in the juvenile hippocampus, demonstrating that the apparently homogeneous glutamatergic cell population displays morpho-functional diversity rooted in temporal embryonic origins (Marissal et al., 2012).
